label: Bible Study
prompt: But thou, O man of God, _____ these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
verse: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
note: Run from the love of money, run toward godliness — Paul's two-way race for Timothy.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be _____.
verse: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
note: Hunger and thirst for what's right, and Jesus promises a full plate — the Beatitudes keep turning empty into filled.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his _____.
verse: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
note: Joseph's dying wish was to have his bones carried out of Egypt — and Moses kept the promise (Exodus 13:19).

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not _____ against it.
verse: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
note: Spoken at Caesarea Philippi right after Peter's confession — Jesus pictures hell on defense, gates and all.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are _____, but not in despair;
verse: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
note: Paul's paradox list: troubled but not distressed, 'perplexed' but not in despair.
